issues: Everything below the fold (categories, products, story, gallery, CTA, footer) stayed invisible on the homepage, mobile, stress and catalog captures: the .reveal elements were hidden until an IntersectionObserver fired, and nothing showed them if it never did. Half the site rendered as a blank beige void.
Stress brand: hyphens:auto broke the hero headline into 'pro-ducent' and 'be-trouwbaar' inside a wide tile. It looks amateurish.
Mobile hero: the stat and map tiles sit alone in half-width rows with an empty column beside them, so the bento falls apart into a ragged list.
Product tile: real photos (Droogijs pellets) were set to contain with 7% padding and a multiply blend, so they floated small and letterboxed in a big grey frame.
The brand-colour CTA tile was mostly empty, with a tiny mono label and a lot of dead yellow/blue space. Only the stat tile used the count-up signature.
Typography and tile system are strong (Bricolage at display sizes, spring hover, pointer spotlight). Creativity is good in the hero but the template reads as generic once the hero ends.
fixed: Added a CSS failsafe animation (revealsafe, 2.4s) to .reveal in template.html and catalog.html. Content now always springs into view even when the observer never fires, and scroll-triggered reveals still work normally.
Changed hyphens:auto to hyphens:manual on the h1 in both files, so the stress headline wraps on whole words.
Mobile hero now uses grid-auto-flow:dense plus explicit ordering. Stat+map and CTA+chips form proper half-width pairs and the bento rhythm holds at 390px.
Added a canvas corner-sample check. Opaque photos get .photo (object-fit:cover, no padding, no multiply) so they fill the frame, while cut-out product shots keep the floating contain look.
The CTA tile now shows the catalog count as a big display number with data-count, so a second number counts up during hero assembly and the brand tile has a strong focal point.
